It is long past time for Congress to take action – and Democrats in the House are ready to pass a comprehensive gun safety bill. Meanwhile, my Republican colleagues have offered either bad solutions or no solutions to the gun violence plaguing America. Some of their "solutions" would actually make gun violence worse. That is one critical reason we need to build on our Democratic majority in the House. = You know me. I look for sensible, pragmatic solutions. The gun bill I support includes a number of sensible, pragmatic solutions to gun violence, supported by strong majorities of Americans. We aim to put in place universal background checks to keep guns out of the hands of criminals; limits on large-capacity magazines and bump stocks to reduce the lethality of weapons; require safe storage, to keep guns out of the hands of children; and raise the legal age for buying semi-automatic rifles to 21. These measures would have kept guns out of the hands of dangerous individuals and saved lives. ---
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yRkW_Sw2xr1MvIXEt6jooTbMnsVYqhUO8Xwt4ORz78ORT8Pt3SALA3pMGVDypeKbyy2kgsjsCmnmy8k7FgsqB6wuCJ9K2SYervuUQSBWz0O6BNFamTrf9xj_vhYGILaoG1pau6ZPJ3xlXhaJyeoKZ9J0XVkIvIKmvK10sZLuNIF27FCvObicvKH_20gA0YJdpqnC3MKoNPRMRJRrlnDSbTLPa-c0ajDLy0icho0oTylzmnUPUHYzGZtvqySVmtypn4BJUlPwh5Eo9vk2DnV-vcdFBxHMWtq-E8Y8AU46QJNfbpumO-gsXQs9gyPN8MoU74ou63wNa0FxbN_oyF-JWN/3mp/wRGeZCQWQ7CP12aZ3n3ijQ/h0/Bhf9ni5KxabrQApyLCoSAR98URxy01OLnR3vH3bhNb4)
| | Dear Peter, Voter turnout in the United States is notoriously low as a general rule. But even by our country‘s sad historical standards, turnout in the jungle primary concluding today remains embarrassingly low. Across the State of California, fewer than 15% of of eligible voters having cast ballots during the early voting period. That means that we enter today’s jungle primary knowing that every vote can make a difference. [**Can you contribute today to put us in a position to sprint through the primary and hit the ground running for the general election cycle?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MK9chKPg1rr185zdjB-MWn-Gk2IyduNRA7y_V3GR_o_76IrxWO-Cm89N_eiiw0q-eFoBFjqNJ6UT3flsw0fZPlUPWyWEcl3KdWYf8Adb_iXPP_eAdkYFgPvT6_-yOwQhBG4zVZJFok_K85P--bcnANaWHtdcxnrQSmYlPGrbQ7nQZ3OsiK62XtKj-Vy6dhZSQR6jBpIei1DmOdnLkb2HR3fjyyJxA2UVx1RT2xxbGlWkzrF3X4OkF7KjSzgjV3kaGfcxt16m-p2S1cFweMGDm_U/3mp/wRGeZCQWQ7CP12aZ3n3ijQ/h1/-azarAhBnBkDqH_t_MhJrm1h8WWHCFKw0VZxkS-VTYM) In 2020, winning the top-two primary made me the first Democrat to ever face the sitting Speaker of the House in a general election. Now, we’re back to build on the unprecedented 81,000 votes that we secured despite a media whiteout, a global pandemic, and a public character assassination relying on (and unfortunately reinforcing) racial and religious stereotypes. Over the course of the primary election cycle, media outlets serving San Francisco have widely chosen to ignore this race entirely. News organizations from CNN and Politico to the LA Times have even written stories presuming the outcome, prognosticating about Pelosi’s plans to put her daughter in her seat presuming that she is allowed—despite documented corruption—to retire on her own terms. [**Your support helps level the field, and ensure that San Franciscans can learn about the options they won’t hear about from most media institutions.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MK9chKPg1rr185zdjB-MWn-Gk2IyduNRA7y_V3GR_o_70BEygXBekT8Kf-Du7XVKJP3drbzz9sn4_H7uWZ-mUxk_Lz12ktG_5D1lN6i7QC9X6Rg3Ks4tYo_GQ0C97PNlBmGij6q_LXDQJ2Inx-fdpffp-pvdS3we11o7dgfB09y03cyEjcE6a_RqPZFWHI2MehIzDsKbu-kmj0y5Bh3aTwHiE9dcJfFs52qNJ6gBl8yuiPEF4NKXbw5nGyFlKkUKXCMOYxqs0R05mHkoL1XYTMM/3mp/wRGeZCQWQ7CP12aZ3n3ijQ/h2/jhsgD8pc21O6q_iez_8_AfwoO-Ew4zfMewfR67q8kxs) That’s one reason why we’ve been so grateful to the few journalists who have shown up for work, like Eric Ting at SF Gate, Valerie Ibarra and “Diamond” Dave Whitaker at Mutiny Radio, SF Examiner columnist Lincoln Mitchell, and Timothy Regan at KPFA. Joined by an Occupy SF organizer, Regan hosted an “[Empathy Circle](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXdN5n2R-EIoQLkfgOd7sP398V4RtQL_Aq1EWFnqsIf0rb73KAJu9WXg0NJ_pEhfR3XljDPa27wNEKJV1sBg8hN-Vx5PAyTWRVkJHrHWsQTnRKqNWHYsuz0ZtJlXo-nZ6POwHW_1sbdjekSZDetpkeJth1ZomnrDwBSAJgJjoCP3sD_7YzUUN2zV0asDphiWEqGAaFU247xuWn2UxpmT_I6gNJhk1fseMqeimaeYBYLN4wvPbK5LvOIw5sNUrzcnwObU88ISmDnLGwzAYl9X9GKnM6ns9-RuQx4lmHoU2cId3/3mp/wRGeZCQWQ7CP12aZ3n3ijQ/h3/_3Mmbs7cq1KnmSRdchhtE9Nv5_Mt_20IcVaDszV19Vo)” among candidates in our race that KPFA 94.1 FM aired this past weekend on his weekly program, “Talk It Out.” It was a fascinating experience, both in substance and process. In process, the Empathy Circle enabled a very different style of dialog from a debate. Unfortunately, even the collaborative and non-adversarial format remained too intimidating for Pelosi to show up. Substantively, it offered a chance to reflect on the incumbent’s sad relationship to democracy.
> “I’ve spent a lot of time...trying to liberate our city’s voice in Washington, noting that the oligarch who inhabits this seat has never debated a challenger in the 35 years that she has held it. [That's] an absolutely preposterous reflection of entitlement and privilege of the worst conceivable kind....[indicating] disrespect for the voters and district...implicit in not showing up for a debate for an entire generation....If you’re not going to debate in public...someone has no business running for office.”
[**Can you join us again today to accelerate our efforts as we move beyond the primary to the general election in November?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MK9chKPg1rr185zdjB-MWn-Gk2IyduNRA7y_V3GR_o_7xrW-2ELcb4vHXTdadma0eaGjunZIkvLTegSw1-KS-46oe2OtygRtOjhYw423QjUopmQQBHYskIfVoM0Zy4BhA_YQUOWe1NS3Cr_9CPxV9ik4Rgv3vn72ou4as-SgCgmhSRRs68IFHjNjrNtJsV6mHh0U27qB4zX0N2uf2vGRA57wpQzXUA4I_X1eW9gj6Hp5_NAYndpwzB1GHukPr5GP44EqlksvLbvVqX_Xgqned2X/3mp/wRGeZCQWQ7CP12aZ3n3ijQ/h4/ygtBzxsw_Vaypes0evL2Bgabwa-051cAI8pz6bWCvHI) Make sure that everyone you know here in San Francisco heads to the polls today! Statistically speaking, it’s more likely than not that they have yet to vote. Your voice nudging your friends can make a bigger difference than you might realize. If incumbents showed up for work by debating opponents, or if news organizations showed up for work by holding them accountable for evading hard questions, we could expect voters to know about their options. But with every institution—from the press to political parties—arrayed against voters, it falls to us to secure democracy. Thanks for standing with us as we challenge an icon of corruption to recover democracy in San Francisco! clean_body: With only 15% of eligible California voters having voted during this year’s early voting period, we encourage every San Franciscan to cast a ballot today. | | | | | Dear Peter, Voter turnout in the United States is notoriously low as a general rule. But even by our country‘s sad historical standards, turnout in the jungle primary concluding today remains embarrassingly low. Across the State of California, fewer than 15% of of eligible voters having cast ballots during the early voting period. That means that we enter today’s jungle primary knowing that every vote can make a difference. In 2020, winning the top-two primary made me the first Democrat to ever face the sitting Speaker of the House in a general election. Now, we’re back to build on the unprecedented 81,000 votes that we secured despite a media whiteout, a global pandemic, and a public character assassination relying on (and unfortunately reinforcing) racial and religious stereotypes. Over the course of the primary election cycle, media outlets serving San Francisco have widely chosen to ignore this race entirely. News organizations from CNN and Politico to the LA Times have even written stories presuming the outcome, prognosticating about Pelosi’s plans to put her daughter in her seat presuming that she is allowed—despite documented corruption—to retire on her own terms. That’s one reason why we’ve been so grateful to the few journalists who have shown up for work, like Eric Ting at SF Gate, Valerie Ibarra and “Diamond” Dave Whitaker at Mutiny Radio, SF Examiner columnist Lincoln Mitchell, and Timothy Regan at KPFA. Joined by an Occupy SF organizer, Regan hosted an “” among candidates in our race that KPFA 94.1 FM aired this past weekend on his weekly program, “Talk It Out.” It was a fascinating experience, both in substance and process. In process, the Empathy Circle enabled a very different style of dialog from a debate. Unfortunately, even the collaborative and non-adversarial format remained too intimidating for Pelosi to show up. Substantively, it offered a chance to reflect on the incumbent’s sad relationship to democracy. “I’ve spent a lot of time...trying to liberate our city’s voice in Washington, noting that the oligarch who inhabits this seat has never debated a challenger in the 35 years that she has held it. [That's] an absolutely preposterous reflection of entitlement and privilege of the worst conceivable kind....[indicating] disrespect for the voters and district...implicit in not showing up for a debate for an entire generation....If you’re not going to debate in public...someone has no business running for office.” Make sure that everyone you know here in San Francisco heads to the polls today! Statistically speaking, it’s more likely than not that they have yet to vote. Your voice nudging your friends can make a bigger difference than you might realize. If incumbents showed up for work by debating opponents, or if news organizations showed up for work by holding them accountable for evading hard questions, we could expect voters to know about their options. But with every institution—from the press to political parties—arrayed against voters, it falls to us to secure democracy. Thanks for standing with us as we challenge an icon of corruption to recover democracy in San Francisco! We know how much the future remains at risk, which is why we defend it at any cost from the failures of the past. Thank you for being part of this historic defense! Together, no depth of corruption can stop us. Now more than ever, we need bold, progressive leaders like John in statewide office to transform public institutions into forces for good that make people’s lives better. As a kid whose life was literally saved by public schools, John brings an incredibly important perspective to the decision-making table because he knows exactly what’s at stake when folks don’t have the resources they need to succeed.
The stakes couldn’t be higher for this race. Education, economic dignity, and health care are all on the ballot this year, and there’s no one better prepared to win — and lead — on these issues than John. But it’s going to require a lot of grassroots support, and John’s biggest fundraising deadline of this campaign is TONIGHT.
**I’ve always liked to say: “We can pray for it to change, but we also have to work for it.”** My friend John exemplifies this to the tee. He is running to lead a state where his great-grandfather was formerly enslaved and to make history as Maryland’s first Black governor. And this deadline is a chance for his campaign to show that his story and message for a more equitable state are resonating with Marylanders and that he has what it takes to win.

The Legislature is still refusing to pass a tax break for Massachusetts families. That's unacceptable. With gas prices hitting a record high of $5 per gallon earlier today, I am not taking 'no' for an answer.
---

---
This afternoon, I issued a call for the Legislature to reconsider its recent work on the state budget to include a new provision that would temporarily suspend the state gas tax through Labor Day.
Here's what I said:
---
| "Today, for the first time ever, the statewide average price of gasoline for Massachusetts drivers reached $5.00 per gallon. This is an unprecedented situation and it's one of many crippling high prices facing Massachusetts residents these days. One way to grant some temporary relief from these prices would be to temporarily suspend the state gas tax. I have long advocated for such a move. However, state lawmakers refused to include any tax relief in the state budget during their recent deliberations. In light of recent events, I am calling on state lawmakers to immediately send the budget from conference committee back to the House, so that a provision for the immediate suspension of the state gas tax from now through Labor Day can be added and sent to the Governor as part of the budget. Further delay and inaction on this important priority is completely unacceptable."
---
|
---
| I was proud to stand up for taxpayers in 2014, when we successfully collected 100,000 signatures and waged a successful ballot campaign against permanent increases in the state gas tax tied to the rate of inflation. Drivers across our state have saved money at the pumps ever since. I am equally proud to stand up for the rights of taxpayers today, and I will continue to fight for your rights as your next Governor.
---

As the former Commanding General of the Infantry Center at Fort Benning and Chief of Infantry, I know a bit about weapons.
#
Derek —
As the former Commanding General of the Infantry Center at Fort Benning and Chief of Infantry, I know a bit about weapons.
Let me state unequivocally, for all intents and purposes, the AR-15 and rifles like it are weapons of war.
Those opposed to an assault weapons ban, especially the NRA, like to play semantic games about the AR-15, pretending there is some meaningful difference between it and the M4 carbine the military carries.
There really isn’t.
The AR-15 is essentially the civilian version of that weapon.
The big differences are barrel length and the ability to shoot three round bursts. The M4 can shoot in bursts, the AR-15 can only shoot a single shot.
But now the AR-15 can be tailored to variable barrel lengths and fitted with either Weaver or Picatinny rails for adding different sights and shooting aids.
And our troops usually use single shot, not burst fire. You’re able to fire much more accurately that way.
That is why the AR-15 is accurately called a weapon of war. It is a very deadly weapon with the same basic functionality that our troops use to kill the enemy.
The NRA knows it's true, but they play games with semantics and they often get away with it.

clean_body: As the former Commanding General of the Infantry Center at Fort Benning and Chief of Infantry, I know a bit about weapons. Derek — As the former Commanding General of the Infantry Center at Fort Benning and Chief of Infantry, I know a bit about weapons. Let me state unequivocally, for all intents and purposes, the AR-15 and rifles like it are weapons of war. Those opposed to an assault weapons ban, especially the NRA, like to play semantic games about the AR-15, pretending there is some meaningful difference between it and the M4 carbine the military carries. There really isn’t. The AR-15 is essentially the civilian version of that weapon. The big differences are barrel length and the ability to shoot three round bursts. The M4 can shoot in bursts, the AR-15 can only shoot a single shot. But now the AR-15 can be tailored to variable barrel lengths and fitted with either Weaver or Picatinny rails for adding different sights and shooting aids. And our troops usually use single shot, not burst fire. You’re able to fire much more accurately that way. That is why the AR-15 is accurately called a weapon of war. It is a very deadly weapon with the same basic functionality that our troops use to kill the enemy. The NRA knows it's true, but they play games with semantics and they often get away with it. But at VoteVets, we are uniquely positioned to push back against the NRA and their talking points. But we need your help to get it done. In yesterday’s first televised debate of the gubernatorial race, former Attorney General Doug Gansler defined himself as the candidate best-suited to take on the number one issue on voters’ minds: crime. | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zJ7b5wNyzKPLhTo-AgqfOTj9hmS-8LvnA8qY7ch-DzunvcfRDuCGxOWfo4oa6_Tn2pEn2ydKKRkalM50ljB1Hxhn5oRNCbGM5-XXjDNL5R4u_1f1vBqJT37QyAuX61RVF8vlYubE4PClm6d9wego_6l_cYtsSCtybOVQUw-G4nVneH15zKUEBYwF5VtTA7DfYlN6MrfdfLW1ORevr5kKcdNm4MVqvVlTGo6-TzNJKEXUs2La_g2UHnJv2Ap-fv2iWvQK57TRYL0cC_6VAvbvh02Ndfcyewazj2s370W_HzxpgQu5xE4gWtoqPXRokUv3ysG22ecPphUQOnRSslswi8pTYcZrzGwLXYb2kltdkTkV9s1CM5Ou7YV3-UUnW5R2tDDZPgxplxTAXpoAXVc8cyg26o42dS7h2Sz78xxuJRl_sIvagQmMsSY9LBYvYdDYM/3mp/H1cqTmliTfqB0CBD1PBhEg/h0/n_9AYOPHCiMwaG_nuzmhEuaaYnhiXstgVSvD0WM0vwI)

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** June 7, 2022 **CONTACT: Katie Baker**

**Gansler Wins First Televised Debate By Centering Crime and Public Safety** _Gansler will hire 1,000 police and put SRO 's in every school_
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDOJPR4Z5lDybbWIPhQSOR8G4v7fq9ZTI8nTPkZ5x8q4rhHpQyjlqNklBCZmOVoCwSg26B1mU6q6g5wuH2Qljc0ZcuS-Cc5FXH7HDtOoMTMiIrKhL7Vn5LT7ehl00PywImYiUkkKvAlt3z87CiN-kAsaWT5FDf4OZ_2ByDmnyvp93-2L0-1kPP0OUxNgqEyh5VIc6Tg2RIveqUeVq4EX4jHOwCTBrRnngm79mskz9l8A1d01PcngBDPFPS4jvfUnt4zzFc9vpfJP9pXL7v6bprviOt94X6zI5nR9WSsx3kYdk1zo0F5ayjE9WgLPwNhznliWOH2OyhFDc6FIS_9UDsVxPX0bRhK3wpfl82XouoWYPklT0_BJ-DArSXeTHZSBT8bLOMWG4mj4EWxkjQb3iMdQ/3mp/H1cqTmliTfqB0CBD1PBhEg/h1/7qQc8KQNeMTG9LBu6siBZ_fcPOO1y-qVpdCmreuysBw)
---
**OWINGS MILLS, Md.** - In yesterday's**[first televised debate ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDOJPR4Z5lDybbWIPhQSOR8G4v7fq9ZTI8nTPkZ5x8q4rhHpQyjlqNklBCZmOVoCwSg26B1mU6q6g5wuH2Qljc0YZiZ9NputdpPc-4WQHM2GhAoCMJLSQbdjnBvsuUOHg1SbaRxncUoCCRdiIyLH0t59zHT4jfQKAfkvEvejmIT-6KNVc17_QLjyefmtkKbwzjrEP6GcfUbSv0TFNyCeIATaGJ52swb_1ST3HOLPn8FOHL-9I3Dbf9De79uhxbFsnq_ekz3K7GDA-6IG4xLn3-MCVssD2JlJzGjeGh_uADKAhJsVlL-v_3ZTy-qt0GM9zTKNv0c1rAlHib_jtbjs0B1LbHTMb6lHpDuhZlP7h9V0NX_-gKWIk-dzXckr4HKhR8aJJvOOD6_3acTpJQ4Uqd8s/3mp/H1cqTmliTfqB0CBD1PBhEg/h2/L1r0lci8NeeZgTFodpKdJDP3W3oEDiy52895RPnjDOE)**of the gubernatorial race, former Attorney General Doug Gansler defined himself as the candidate best-suited to take on the number one issue on voters' minds: crime. The event was sponsored by WBAL and Maryland Public Television. Gansler's opening statement and response to a question on crime are transcribed below. His public safety plan can be read at **[safemaryland.com.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/CMxF4nARlf6wAFa1PSfv0jlFmy0tHsxupmAVrXqus7XTsEmUAegbPULqCVpnZ-BzfvBEjeVgZlzRpITo-T1O8aTLCYafa_7RczsDYSv7bdzCeTcjhF2EZ4dnEWNEUsG6carhMPtpgfztsh1RBswSaIFajtCIVGiSztm7GmSvuX9PuEcHLGBLPAErXUuur8LLFnuJlstXxt8mVfp_zybN55TFTaEIGF3X4fRpxkVWX1xUhJkLs80QZG5BxrYxQznVgqqDCxq0GYWcvzOesOe3u5T8VBpodu8DYM4fwcbtIDbYNykCgJbrEdimGCtmU6b0ziGqKYY80fQnjRSYW44Tpgw9GHR8Ucrj_6Q3POR9X580LANOpFRQE30F6KlBLjjZ/3mp/H1cqTmliTfqB0CBD1PBhEg/h3/2PgQcHs5VhaukB522HFbBFjy6q7LytWc8YUrqSdTD58)** **Opening Statement:** "This election is about crime and criminal justice. I spent six years as a federal prosecutor, I spent eight years as State's Attorney of Montgomery County, and I spent eight years as your elected Attorney General. "I've been fighting criminals and gun crimes for 22 years. I recognize that we need to bring crime down while lifting justice up, and I recognize that crime occurs in disproportionately underserved areas and in communities of color. "There's no other candidate in this debate that has any background whatsoever in criminal justice. Think about that. The most important issue in people's minds right now is crime and criminal justice and nobody here has any background in that whatsoever. So what we're going to do as the only pro-business, pro-law enforcement candidate in this field is we're going to put 1,000 more police officers on the streets, trained in de-escalation techniques, we're going to put an SRO in every school so that your children are safe when you take them to school, and as the only major candidate who grew up in Maryland, I want to help you make Maryland safe again." **Gansler further elaborated on his credentials and vision in the following response: ** "In terms of judges, currently the Chief Judge of the Court of Appeals of Maryland and the Chief Judge of the Court of Special Appeals in Maryland worked in my office. I hired both of them. We need to have the best and brightest and smartest judges. Judges that understand that a woman has an absolute right to reproductive choice, that climate change is a real threat, but most importantly that crime is ravaging us. It's holding Maryland back from its future. I argued in front of the United States Supreme Court. I won a unanimous decision keeping a sex offender in jail in Western Maryland. I ran the Joint Sniper Task Force, the Beltway Snipers, and we brought them to justice. I started the first domestic violence dockets, the first drug courts, the first family justice center in Maryland's history. We'll be bringing those in around the state. I started the first [fully-implemented] community prosecution office in the United States to work with community police. Crime is holding us back. We need somebody that understands how to fix that. It's not summer camps or worrying about parole agents."
---
### _Former Attorney General Doug Gansler is running for governor to make Maryland safe. Gansler has 22 years of experience fighting crime - first as a federal prosecutor, then as Montgomery County State's Attorney, and finally as Attorney General. In addition to prosecuting some of the state's most high-profile cases, including the Beltway Sniper, Gansler has a record of launching innovative and successful programs to protect the public while instituting progressive reforms to the criminal justice system. _ _Former Hyattsville Mayor Candace Hollingsworth was the city 's youngest and first Black mayor. After a combined nine years of service on City Council and as mayor, Candace founded the national organization Our Black Party to wake folks up and fortify a change-making relationship between the Black community and the political system. As mayor, Candace focused on making Hyattsville a safe and just community through expanding education, economic opportunities and civic engagement for young people while supporting the long-term sustainability of her city._
---
By Authority: Friends of Doug Gansler, Terry Denney, Treasurer; Ana Sol Gutierrez, Chair.

clean_body: In yesterday’s first televised debate of the gubernatorial race, former Attorney General Doug Gansler defined himself as the candidate best-suited to take on the number one issue on voters’ minds: crime. | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE June 7, 2022 CONTACT: Katie Baker Gansler Wins First Televised Debate By Centering Crime and Public Safety Gansler will hire 1,000 police and put SRO 's in every school | OWINGS MILLS, Md. - In yesterday's the gubernatorial race, former Attorney General Doug Gansler defined himself as the candidate best-suited to take on the number one issue on voters' minds: crime. The event was sponsored by WBAL and Maryland Public Television. Gansler's opening statement and response to a question on crime are transcribed below. His public safety plan can be read at Opening Statement: "This election is about crime and criminal justice. I spent six years as a federal prosecutor, I spent eight years as State's Attorney of Montgomery County, and I spent eight years as your elected Attorney General. "I've been fighting criminals and gun crimes for 22 years. I recognize that we need to bring crime down while lifting justice up, and I recognize that crime occurs in disproportionately underserved areas and in communities of color. "There's no other candidate in this debate that has any background whatsoever in criminal justice. Think about that. The most important issue in people's minds right now is crime and criminal justice and nobody here has any background in that whatsoever. So what we're going to do as the only pro-business, pro-law enforcement candidate in this field is we're going to put 1,000 more police officers on the streets, trained in de-escalation techniques, we're going to put an SRO in every school so that your children are safe when you take them to school, and as the only major candidate who grew up in Maryland, I want to help you make Maryland safe again." Gansler further elaborated on his credentials and vision in the following response: "In terms of judges, currently the Chief Judge of the Court of Appeals of Maryland and the Chief Judge of the Court of Special Appeals in Maryland worked in my office. I hired both of them. We need to have the best and brightest and smartest judges. Judges that understand that a woman has an absolute right to reproductive choice, that climate change is a real threat, but most importantly that crime is ravaging us. It's holding Maryland back from its future. I argued in front of the United States Supreme Court. I won a unanimous decision keeping a sex offender in jail in Western Maryland. I ran the Joint Sniper Task Force, the Beltway Snipers, and we brought them to justice. I started the first domestic violence dockets, the first drug courts, the first family justice center in Maryland's history. We'll be bringing those in around the state. I started the first [fully-implemented] community prosecution office in the United States to work with community police. Crime is holding us back. We need somebody that understands how to fix that. It's not summer camps or worrying about parole agents." Former Attorney General Doug Gansler is running for governor to make Maryland safe. Gansler has 22 years of experience fighting crime - first as a federal prosecutor, then as Montgomery County State's Attorney, and finally as Attorney General. In addition to prosecuting some of the state's most high-profile cases, including the Beltway Sniper, Gansler has a record of launching innovative and successful programs to protect the public while instituting progressive reforms to the criminal justice system. Former Hyattsville Mayor Candace Hollingsworth was the city 's youngest and first Black mayor. After a combined nine years of service on City Council and as mayor, Candace founded the national organization Our Black Party to wake folks up and fortify a change-making relationship between the Black community and the political system. As mayor, Candace focused on making Hyattsville a safe and just community through expanding education, economic opportunities and civic engagement for young people while supporting the long-term sustainability of her city. Instead of taking meaningful action that would actually make our schools and communities safer, Governor Mike DeWine and his GOP allies are bowing to the gun lobby’s outrageous alternative.
**[Congress is unlikely to take action and Mike DeWine is utterly failing Ohioans on this issue. Our best hope for addressing gun violence in Ohio is to elect a governor who will take real, meaningful action. I promise to be that governor. Chip in to our campaign now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46242381/349426388/1377392479?refcode=nw_email_220607_1_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTAxZGFjOC1hMmU2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=10le2GlfBHywBzf_vJPVBq5diBx27IQfuZJ1LLof2TE=)**
I was mayor of Dayton when our city experienced its own devastating mass shooting and I was there when Mike DeWine promised to “do something” to curb gun violence in its wake.
Instead, he did the exact opposite. Rather than push for common sense legislation to make our communities safer, DeWine signed laws removing training and permit requirements for concealed carry in Ohio. Now he’s poised to sign a law to put more guns in our schools.
Meanwhile, we’ve been waiting for more than a decade on congressional action to address gun violence with little hope of progress.

subject: Stop the anti-life movement

| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [[](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyFUMtqxDAM_Jrk5hDbqeMcclhY9rallEKPRnXkrKkfwXbo79fZbaG3gi6SZkajWeZFL0B1a2fWM9aLfqRimKjoEJGDkSPSHidmZDP04DCVLuG2fzirIRTInyYmjZ2Ovr3NlE5ScymfEMQoBGdaDDgZI6dRDlyb9v2qrmCdDeszeJxTMSplFUCBtmRL0VmDSpCRMKZo6-ZbKVtu-Klhl1rRGEy5q8x0XNcxhdqXGLCLaa2AqkAOCZILFPQYykHkl714leNejTb8XEF5Q12qiYaJY-VxsbuvK_TV3M9Qg9_AruHBUHdnf2QfmBjK0fHzy4m8vl3Ib4RtmpftyzpnsxhrcOshfA-p_PP0N-gPho4)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyFUMtqxDAM_Jrk5hDbqeMcclhY9rallEKPRnXkrKkfwXbo79fZbaG3gi6SZkajWeZFL0B1a2fWM9aLfqRimKjoEJGDkSPSHidmZDP04DCVLuG2fzirIRTInyYmjZ2Ovr3NlE5ScymfEMQoBGdaDDgZI6dRDlyb9v2qrmCdDeszeJxTMSplFUCBtmRL0VmDSpCRMKZo6-ZbKVtu-Klhl1rRGEy5q8x0XNcxhdqXGLCLaa2AqkAOCZILFPQYykHkl714leNejTb8XEF5Q12qiYaJY-VxsbuvK_TV3M9Qg9_AruHBUHdnf2QfmBjK0fHzy4m8vl3Ib4RtmpftyzpnsxhrcOshfA-p_PP0N-gPho4) I’ve created a new pro-life pledge; I’d love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyFUMtqxDAM_Jrk5hDbqeMcclhY9rallEKPRnXkrKkfwXbo79fZbaG3gi6SZkajWeZFL0B1a2fWM9aLfqRimKjoEJGDkSPSHidmZDP04DCVLuG2fzirIRTInyYmjZ2Ovr3NlE5ScymfEMQoBGdaDDgZI6dRDlyb9v2qrmCdDeszeJxTMSplFUCBtmRL0VmDSpCRMKZo6-ZbKVtu-Klhl1rRGEy5q8x0XNcxhdqXGLCLaa2AqkAOCZILFPQYykHkl714leNejTb8XEF5Q12qiYaJY-VxsbuvK_TV3M9Qg9_AruHBUHdnf2QfmBjK0fHzy4m8vl3Ib4RtmpftyzpnsxhrcOshfA-p_PP0N-gPho4) Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson

Good afternoon, team. This is my last message to you before ballots are due this evening in the California Primary. **To everyone who has donated, knocked on doors, and sent in their ballot — thank you. Our democracy is only as strong as we make it.** After the January 6 insurrection, I talked with many fellow veterans who were alarmed that our politicians were undermining our elections, throwing facts out the window to gain points with their base. We discussed the need for representatives with more integrity — and less career politicians. That was one reason I decided to run for Congress. **Last week on the debate stage both of my Republican opponents said “I don’t know” when asked if Joe Biden won the 2020 election.** It was a stark reminder of what’s at stake in this election. | |
---
| | Hi Everyone,

Nick De Gregorio here with an important update.

On Election Day, instead of constructively engaging voters, my opponent is accusing me of being anti-parent. That is quite the Hail Mary.

I am the parent of two toddlers. While Frank Pallotta was talking about the formula crisis, _my wife and I were actually living it_. I speak every single day about the challenges we face as parents today and the importance of parental choice. It is a major reason behind my decision to run for Congress. Do not let Frank Pallotta's recent mailer and text message fool you or other parents:**I have always been opposed to Governor Murphy's despicable new curriculum standards, and I have always supported the right for parents to make medical decisions for their children.** Anything said to the contrary is a LIE...and one funded by Josh Gottheimer himself.

It is sad to see the lengths a politician will go when they are desperate. I can’t help but feel bad for my friend Frank. From lying about me to being **[supported by Josh Gottheimer in his race](https://nickfornj.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d957ded20397fa5245442e969&id=4ae561a64b&e=31104c58a7)** , I am truly ashamed of the person politics has turned him into.

We feel the momentum out there, but please help us by heading to the polls by 8:00 PM and voting Column 2 in Bergen County.

Thanks for all of your support. Please contact Luke (luke@nickfornj.com) if you need any help.

Nick

subject: We found Dr. Oz’s voter registration…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
I wish this was a joke...
#
Derek,
Today is Primary Election Day in New Jersey, and I can’t help but wonder who Dr. Oz is going to vote for... 🤔
I wish this was a joke, but I’m being 💯 serious.
**Dr. Oz is literally still registered to vote in New Jersey — which is notably *not* Pennsylvania.**
Here’s his voter registration on file (it’s a public record so ANYONE can look this up) 👇
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220607-1?refcode=em20220607-6132&refcode2=6132_434096_UygzWh&akid=6132%2E434096%2EUygzWh)
Not only is Dr. Oz STILL registered to vote in New Jersey, Derek:
**What *really* gets me is that this quack celebrity TV doctor has been registered to vote there since the 1980s!!!! 😂**
To visualize this considerable passage of time, here’s a shot of *yours truly* from, uh, sometime in the late 80s.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220607-1?refcode=em20220607-6132&refcode2=6132_434096_UygzWh&akid=6132%2E434096%2EUygzWh)
Derek, I can’t believe I have to keep saying this, but...
**I ACTUALLY LIVE IN PA!!!**
I was born + raised here, and now Gisele + I are raising our family here, right across the street from Andrew Carnegie’s first steel mill.
I’m running for U.S. Senate to fight for every community, every family, and every person. I *know* Pennsylvanians because I *am* one. My opponent can’t say the same.
[**_Can you make a donation of $5 or more to our campaign today? We are the campaign that will fight for each and every one of yinz + youse._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220607-1?refcode=em20220607-6132&refcode2=6132_434096_UygzWh&akid=6132%2E434096%2EUygzWh)

Thanks,
John

Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania*
*NOT NEW JERSEY!!!!!!

body:
Our work is not done.
#

Friends -
We are pretty sure that when you woke up this morning, you didn’t immediately think today would be the day you made your first online contribution to Giffords PAC.
We could have never imagined that after receiving more than 1 million donations, we’d have to ask people to keep contributing. But that is what we have to do today. We have to ask you to join those donors.
Because, sadly and obviously, our work is not done.
There is an FEC deadline this month. And the next time we publicly report our donation totals, we need to report lots and lots of donations—because we need the Senate to know the movement for change is larger than ever.
And if they don’t act, then we’ll put your donation to work electing a Congress that will.
So yes. If you have been waiting for the time to make your first donation to Giffords PAC, today is the day.

My special election is tomorrow, and I need your help.

Our country is at a crossroads. Out-of-touch politicians in Washington want to tax and spend their way out of every problem, debt is skyrocketing, the federal budget is ballooning, and the Democrat majority is only making things worse.

I promise you, I'm willing to put up a fight. I'm ready to roll up my sleeves on day one and get to work slashing budgets, cutting taxes, standing up to liberal special interests, and standing up for the American people. I won't stop when the going gets tough.

subject: 48 hours on the campaign trail
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220607&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220607&amount=28]
Team,
The campaign is in high gear over here on Team Slotkin. Last weekend was packed with events, so I thought I’d give you a look at what we’ve been up to and let you in on some of the things I’m hearing about on the road!
First up was our Day of Action canvass launch bright and early on Saturday morning. Some of our most dedicated volunteers – and a whole host of first-timers -- joined me at our campaign headquarters to kick off the day. They headed out to knock doors in the new parts of the district – Eaton, Clinton, and Shiawassee counties – as well as the communities across the existing parts of the district to ask *them* what they want out of their representative.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220607&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220607&amount=28]
That afternoon, I joined gun violence survivors in Lansing as they talked about their experiences and demanded more from those who represent them. It’s been an extremely tough year with gun violence, from the rise of shootings in Lansing to the Oxford High School shooting 6 months ago. Something is so incredibly broken in our system when gun violence is now the leading cause of death for children in the United States – think about that. It's why the refusal of my colleagues to just come to the table with an open heart to negotiate reasonable changes gets me so frustrated.
I ended my day on Saturday at Curwood Festival in Owosso. So many people came out for carnival rides, a two hour parade, and even some petting zoo goats!
Then it was on to a full Sunday of friend-raisers in Laingsburg, St. Johns, and Dewitt. We started friend-raisers after folks asked me how they could get their networks involved in my campaign. They’re a great way to meet new folks from the communities in the new district, and meet new friends in the counties I already represent.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220607&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220607&amount=28]
Here’s what I heard: supply chain issues continue to impact Michigan and the entire country. Microchips, of course, but also stories of how hospitals are canceling surgeries because they can’t get their hands on $2 medical supplies. I also heard a tremendous amount of concern about gun violence, including from ardent gun owners, hunters, and sportsmen. This reinforced the feeling that we must do something to try and push back on the leading cause of death for children in America.
One of my favorite parts of days like these is all of the small businesses I get to visit along the way. Over the course of the weekend I was able grab coffee and pastries at Tammy’s Bakery and Cafe in Laingsburg (featuring the biggest donut holes I’ve ever seen), visit The Studio Shop and Fireworks Glass Studio in Williamston and Knotty Fun Yarn in Perry, grab lunch at St. John's Brewing Company, and carry out dinner at Old Nation Brewery in Williamston.
I wrapped up Sunday at a thank-you event for some of the wonderful volunteers who helped us collect 5,000 petition nominating signatures to help me get on the ballot. It’s not an exaggeration to say that this group *quite literally* moves mountains. This is also the first event where I’ve ever gotten to participate in a round of “Elissa Slotkin Trivia” featuring a fair share of stories from my past.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220607&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220607&amount=28]
Over the course of this weekend, I had a ton of new people thank me for being “normal and practical" (their words!). People are desperately looking for a representative who will work to find a consensus and who is focused on delivering actual results. It’s such a simple ask, and says so much about what people have come to expect from their representatives. This is the low bar I will continue to try to leap over as I run in the new 7th district.

Peter, after the
latest wave of progressive primaries, we saw this piece — and we couldn’t
agree more.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110214?refcode=em20220607-23733&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=23733%2E1203867%2EkBqMUa ]Headline from Salon reads To keep winning, progressives must do more
than grassroots organizing: we need money. Sub-headline reads Summer Lee's
victory shows how progressives can beat super PACs: by fighting - and
winning - the money war

Corporate Super PACs affiliated with AIPAC, Silicon Valley billionaires,
and corporate Democrats in Washington will continue spending millions
against our candidates, just like they did against Summer Lee and Jessica
Cisneros. We have no choice but to increase the amount of grassroots
funding we have on the progressive side.

Despite $3 million of right-wing foreign policy hawk money spent against
Summer, her fundraising and our progressive coalition’s resources kept her
within roughly a 2-to-1 spending disadvantage. Summer and our coalition
spent a little over $2 million on her primary, while corporate Democrats
and billionaires spent about $4.5 million against us.

Here’s the reality: the Democratic establishment was caught off-guard when
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez defeated the 4th most powerful Democrat in the
House in 2018. They were still on their heels when Cori Bush and Jamaal
Bowman defeated corporate Democrats in 2020. They are not taking us for
granted any longer,
Peter.

Our next primary is on June 28th, when Kina Collins takes on a corporate
Pelosi-backed 26-year incumbent Democrat in Chicago. Super PACs are
already spending big money against Kina. And corporate donors helped her
opponent raise over $400,000 last quarter. We need your help to win this
race.

This is such a critical moment for our movement. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110214?refcode=em20220607-23733&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=23733%2E1203867%2EkBqMUa ]Can you split a
donation to Kina’s campaign and Justice Democrats to make sure we can win
this race? If we collectively can fund just 50% of what corporate
Democrats are spending on this race, we know we can be competitive.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110214?refcode=em20220607-23733&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=23733%2E1203867%2EkBqMUa ]Contribute

Thank you for all that you do to support our work and our primary
candidates.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1023&akid=23733%2E1203867%2EkBqMUa ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Alessandra Biaggi
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We have an incredible opportunity to continue building power in Congress by electing Alessandra — but only if we stand together.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220607-3086-header&t=1&akid=3086%2E2526796%2E8Uk6Yz)
**I’m so proud to share that I’m endorsing Alessandra Biaggi for Congress in New York’s 17th district.**
Like us, Alessandra is funding her campaign the right way, and is counting on a surge of grassroots supporters to stand with her here in the early stages of this race. [Can you split a $6 contribution between Alessandra and our campaign today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220607.BNhCZc&refcode=em20220607-3086-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3086%2E2526796%2E8Uk6Yz)
**[Contribute $6](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220607.BNhCZc&refcode=em20220607-3086-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3086%2E2526796%2E8Uk6Yz)**
As a State Senator, Alessandra arrived in Albany to a government plagued by gridlock — one caused by conservatives in our own party, rampant corruption, and cronyism at the highest levels.
Through hard work, Alessandra and our progressive allies across New York were able to break through and deliver a series of wins — including codifying _Roe_ statewide and expanding voting rights.
Now, she's ready to take her leadership to Congress where I know she’ll continue fighting for working people. We can count on her to stand with our movement on critical issues such as abortion rights, championing the Green New Deal and Medicare for All, and fighting to raise the minimum wage.
Like all candidates I’ve endorsed, we have an incredible opportunity to continue building progressive power by electing Alessandra — but only if we stand together.
This is going to be a competitive and expensive race.**She’s running against a well-funded opponent, Sean Patrick Maloney, who also happens to be the chairman of the DCCC.**
Alessandra has been here before — she knows what it takes to go up against powerful opponents and win. But the only way she can do that is if we all get involved and stand with her when it matters most.
[This is where you come in. Can you split a $6 contribution to stand with Alessandra and our campaign’s efforts mobilizing voters across New York and the entire country?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220607.BNhCZc&refcode=em20220607-3086-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3086%2E2526796%2E8Uk6Yz)
Your contribution today will have a tremendous impact on the outlook of this primary. Thanks for adding yours if you can.
Pa’lante,
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220607?refcode=em20220607-3086-P_FND_ANO_END&t=23&refcode2=3086_2526796_8Uk6Yz&akid=3086%2E2526796%2E8Uk6Yz)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20220607-3086-P_FND_ANO_END&t=24&akid=3086%2E2526796%2E8Uk6Yz)**

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: Legacy media’s lies
body:
[****](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60536490:JOkGb_oNP:m:1:3253819041:8AC0E0C7C653F958AAABD4C89241C72C:r)

Peter,
**Our country is currently facing a great threat.** A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize.
This enemy is the radical vigilante woke mob that will steamroll anything and anyone in their way. Their blatant attacks on the American way of life are clear and intensifying: stifling dissent, public shaming, rampant violence, and a perverted version of history.
A group that will, literally, tear down monuments and buildings but -- perhaps in an even more sinister way -- tear down the American spirit itself. **They go after the family unit, parental rights, traditional moral values, the church, and fact-based education.**
Over the past few years, we've watched horrified as this group has attempted to _**brainwash our children**_ into thinking we live in an evil, racist, irredeemable country.
We listened to them deny science and data to exert political theater all the while _**trampling over personal liberties enshrined in the Constitution.**_
[**> > DONATE NOW TO HELP US CONTINUE THE FIGHT <<**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60536490:JOkGb_oNP:m:1:3253819041:8AC0E0C7C653F958AAABD4C89241C72C:r)
We saw them take to the streets for an entire summer like outlaws burning, looting, and destroying everything in sight while being told they were "mostly peaceful" and "passionate."
We watched _**Big Tech moguls in Silicon Valley be the arbiters of truth**_ - deciding who gets to speak and who gets silenced through the digital public square.
We listened to the legacy media muffle legitimately verifiable news stories that didn't align with their preferred narrative, only to watch the truth trickle out months later at a more politically expedient time.
**Well,****Peter****, the time for listening and watching from the sidelines is over.**
This enemy has taken over media, educational institutions, corporate boards, professional sports, foundations, and professional institutions. They have left no corner of our lives untouched. But all hope is not lost.
**We The People still have a say.** We know the truth, you and I, about America and the country she is and can be. We must fight to defeat these false pretenses and predetermined narratives.
**I am choosing to counter this enemy with faith, with reason, and with freedom. As Governor of the Free State of Florida, I have chosen to lead with a vision that builds America up rather than tears it down.**
Together we can ensure that our children are raised to know they live in the greatest state in the nation, the greatest country in the world and that they have an opportunity to continue making them even greater.
[**If you 've been waiting for the right time to get off the sidelines and fight for the rights you know were given to man by God Himself - the time is NOW.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60536490:JOkGb_oNP:m:1:3253819041:8AC0E0C7C653F958AAABD4C89241C72C:r)
[**If you 're with me, **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60536490:JOkGb_oNP:m:1:3253819041:8AC0E0C7C653F958AAABD4C89241C72C:r)[**Peter****, chip in any amount to help me defeat this enemy.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60536490:JOkGb_oNP:m:1:3253819041:8AC0E0C7C653F958AAABD4C89241C72C:r) I can't do it without you. I promise you; I will _**never**_ stop fighting.
Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

Here’s an argument that I don’t buy: Some people say that debates on gun safety are about individual rights and the role of government. But right-wing extremists who oppose any action on gun reform aren’t exactly consistent from issue to issue. They don’t want the government to be able to stop someone from being as fully armed as possible. But they do want the government to be able to swoop into a private decision between a pregnant woman, her doctor, and her loved ones. What’s more, far-right Republicans have shown that they’re not interested in doing anything for babies after they’re born. Their silence on issues like gun reform, universal child care and pre-k, and public school funding has made that crystal clear. And where are their bright ideas to support the Biden administration’s work to get more baby formula back on shelves? All I’ve seen are pointed fingers, and all I’ve heard are crickets. So here’s the way I see it: this fight isn’t about big government vs. small government — it’s about right-wing extremists trying to use the power of the government when it suits them to advance a dangerous, out-of-touch, far-right agenda. **I’m going to do everything I can to keep Republicans out of power in these midterm elections. I’m going to do my part to expand our Democratic majorities so we can abolish the filibuster and deliver more results. And as the Supreme Court prepares to rule on restricting abortion access and loosening gun laws, I’m going to keep fighting to expand the Court. | We’re getting closer to the election and our next quarterly deadline, so it’s important that we raise as much as we can to grow our movement. But before I ask you to [_**contribute to our movement today**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46246358/349443213/-1304906161?refcode=BLU-HODG-20220607-1-EM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI5NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZmU4ZTZiOC1iMmU2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=y2HvDoSM_lhD1FOqyfKqu26whwHKg14CfzV1WcwhHl0=), I wanted to share three reasons why this election is so important:
1. This is a crucial seat to flip if we want to hold onto the Democratic majority in Congress. Super PACs are pouring money into Republican campaigns, so we need to do all we can to hold them accountable and fight back. _**President Biden won this district by 1.5% in 2020, so we have a real shot at flipping this seat.**_
2. Representation matters. Arizona has never had a Black member of Congress, but we have the opportunity to change that this year. If elected, I would be the first Black member of Congress from Arizona, and I would be honored to represent my community in such a monumental way.
3. So many critical issues are on the line. I’m ready to fight for the things that matter, like lowering healthcare costs, increasing investments in our education system, and passing legislation to combat climate change.

[_**So, friend, I hope you’ll consider joining our movement by pitching in today. We have a real shot of flipping this seat blue and making history, and I’d really appreciate your support!**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46246359/349443214/-1304906161?refcode=BLU-HODG-20220607-1-EM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI5NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZmU4ZTZiOC1iMmU2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=y2HvDoSM_lhD1FOqyfKqu26whwHKg14CfzV1WcwhHl0=)

Super PACs are pouring money into Republican campaigns, so we need to do all we can to hold them accountable and fight back. https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engelaz?refcode=X_060722_CampaignTrail [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engelaz?refcode=X_060722_CampaignTrail] Finally, this month we honor & celebrate the LGBTQ+ community & the freedom to be who you are & love who you love. This fight is ALL our fight. With many of our rights under attack, we need to ensure Kirsten has the support she needs to fight for bold action. Republicans are going to do their best to convince you that our support is fizzling out. But, we have the receipts!
Will you chip in today and help support Kirsten as she continues to knock on doors and mobilize for our rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engelaz?refcode=X_060722_CampaignTrail]

Happy Pride! Each June we celebrate our LGBTQ+ community and all we have accomplished for people to live authentic, fulfilling lives. This June, as we celebrate we also recognize the relentless attacks on LGBTQ+ people in Texas and across the country.
To kick off Pride month, Lizzie gathered with members and supporters of Houston’s LGBTQ+ community in Montrose, which will be a part of #TX07 in the next Congress after redistricting.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220607wu?refcode=lpfe220607wu_m [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220607wu?refcode=lpfe220607wu_m]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220607wu?refcode=lpfe220607wu_m [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220607wu?refcode=lpfe220607wu_m]
Lizzie is proud to stand with LGBTQ+ Texans and to fight for them in Congress, and was thrilled to connect those gathered with Congressman David Cicilline, co-chair of the Congressional Equality Caucus to talk about the work we have done and the work we have to do.
And this month, the Equality PAC has endorsed Lizzie for re-election!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220607wu?refcode=lpfe220607wu_m [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220607wu?refcode=lpfe220607wu_m]
The Equality PAC works to elect LGBTQ+ leaders and allies who champion full civil rights and protections for the LGBTQ+ community. Here is what they had to say about Lizzie:
“Since her start in Congress, Congresswoman Fletcher has been a staunch advocate for the LGBTQ community in Texas and across the nation," said Equality PAC Co-Chairs Chairman Mark Takano and Congressman David Cicilline. "From fiercely advocating for passage of the Equality Act to standing up against discrimination towards LGBTQ Texans, Congresswoman Fletcher perfectly exemplifies what it means to be an ally. To achieve full equality for all LGBTQ Americans and defend LGBTQ Texans from the attacks led by Greg Abbott and his band of bigots, we need solid and longtime allies like Congresswoman Fletcher in the House. Equality PAC is proud to stand with her as she campaigns for re-election to Congress."
Equality PAC is the political arm of the Congressional LGBTQ Equality Caucus and is dedicated to the full legal and societal equality for LGBTQ Americans. All funds raised into Equality PAC are spent supporting and electing openly LGBTQ individuals and strong LGBTQ allies to the United States Congress who are committed to passing the Equality ACT and to ensuring full civil rights and protections for all LGBTQ America.
We are so glad Equality PAC is part of this team, and that you are, too.
Thanks,
Team Lizzie

| | **ICYMI: Attorney General Derek Schmidt and Legislature secure big KPERS win for Kansas**
---
**By Jeff King

** [**_May 26, 2022, The Topeka Capital-Journal._**](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=f9c2d521c1dd4cbabb1cf0cb09408f53&_e=_wKtWOxJ5f37QBagUVB9QwCdU4UngloJW3QYtXRL6AmXa7DwnlxWq1L6KVS4ddGxUCVDgQmvNkF4IhRbCyvJa-2RuUSjIN3x0MbDT_0ey4OfSj6idaBuqnHQ7M_85SAOlC7JVEHEss9qnOPcuw-A7xARzySzuWIZM1H8ob9Je4Z8WlYAEh0CZhBzqdLebivUEm84jfUTEqLU3yJNh4T3pRFQC5qg4CtWt7C2-wrUSJXrCvRCuoEKwRrd8euvrqXTyyG9pmFM-UtVWVVSdXzS0WyE2l6woMgIRQzKTpMJfpAqxk803eK-hvelvbgMAOwQIVJPkMegetwgDE9sONVB4DWAfLYg0VFKAmdFohx6GYWd84onU2uO_t-ZvxkwcfmfDqYj-z4YHdcmdWnUrHefVA%3D%3D)

When I served in the Kansas Senate, reforming the Kansas Public Employee Retirement System and reducing its massive unfunded liability were two of my biggest priorities.

It was the right thing for taxpayers who pay the bills and the roughly 315,000 teachers, state employees, and other public servants who count on KPERS for their retirement. Every dollar saved for KPERS provided one more dollar for retirees and one less paid by taxpayers.

As chair of the Senate KPERS Committee, I sparred for years with the committee’s ranking Democrat. The KPERS Study Commission I co-chaired recommended a new system that would reduce future KPERS costs and risks for taxpayers. The ranking Democrat opposed this effort.

When we had the chance to save Kansas taxpayers hundreds of millions of dollars by restructuring KPERS debt, the ranking Democrat opposed it. At every turn, her solution to KPERS’ problems was spending more taxpayer money.

That ranking Democrat was our now-Gov. Laura Kelly.

Her tune has not changed. In 2012, she supported paying all KPERS liabilities by 2032. Yet, three times as governor, she went back on her word. She tried repeatedly to re-amortize KPERS debt — essentially refinancing those payments to save a small amount now by adding billions in future debt.

The KPERS Board of Trustees three times opposed her plan. Republicans in the Legislature three times rejected it.

That's why I was surprised when Gov. Kelly took credit for legislation paying down $1.1 billion of KPERS’ debt, an effort that she previously opposed. “Balancing the budget, paying off debt, and providing financial relief for Kansans" was never her priority, at least concerning KPERS.

In my 10 years as a legislator, I never heard her suggest using state balances to lower KPERS debt. Rather, increasing spending and growing state government was her priority.

Her statements hide the real cause of this success — the hard work of my predecessor in the Kansas Senate, our Attorney General Derek Schmidt.

Schmidt called on the Legislature to prepay at least $1 billion in KPERS debt this year. He worked with legislators on both sides of the aisle, including Speaker Ryckman and Senate President Masterson. Schmidt’s tenacity and leadership, not any action from the governor’s office, got the job done.

By eliminating more than $1.1 billion in debt and accelerating full KPERS funding, Schmidt’s plan will save taxpayers nearly $100 million annually. That’s $100 million every year for schools, law enforcement, roads and bridges, and tax cuts for Kansans who need them most. Schmidt has said “paying debt is not sexy.” He’s right. But it is common sense — the type that Kansas families understand. Kansas needs leadership that isn’t flashy or attention-grabbing but prioritizes practical solutions.

Kansans want the bills paid on time, unnecessary debt avoided, core services (like schools and public safety) run well and taxes as low as possible. This KPERS debt buydown shows the quality leadership we can expect under a Governor Schmidt.

I’ve known Derek for 40 years. Unlike most politicians, self-aggrandizement isn’t his thing. Steady vision, sound governance and common-sense solutions have been the trademarks of his time serving Kansas.

His KPERS work is yet another reminder of how much we need Derek’s leadership as governor.

_Jeff King, a Republican from Independence, is the former vice president of the Kansas Senate.

clean_body: Our community isn’t done fighting and neither am I. | | | Peter, this is urgent. Did you see Jessica’s email yesterday? With only a 281 gap in votes, we’re officially filing for a recount. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: Thank you for your support, Team Cisneros \--------Forwarded message-------- Sender: Jessica Cisneros Date: Monday, June 6, 2022 Subject: BREAKING: We’re filing for a recount Peter, The results for Texas’ 28th runoff election were certified today — and there is only a gap of 281 votes. And today, we’re officially filing for a recount. Our movement was never just about one politician — it was about taking on an unjust system that rewards corruption and corporate profits at the expense of the needs of working people. With a vote margin of just under 0.6 percent, I owe it to my community to see this through to the end. Regardless of the outcome, we’re proving that South Texas isn’t satisfied with business as usual anymore and we’re ready for fundamental change — this is just the beginning. To help cover the cost of the recount, we launched a new fund to raise what we need to make sure every vote is counted and every voice is heard. We know Cuellar is going to spend as much money as possible on legal challenges, and we need to be ready to counter these challenges. This is our opportunity to ensure we elect a fresh voice, a pro-union leader, a champion for reproductive rights who reflects the future of the Democratic party. We are done with the status quo. Thank you for fighting with us, Jessica Cisneros | To give by check: PO Box 660 Laredo, TX 78042

body:
TV stations across North Carolina pulled down their attack ad against me.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14116?t=6&akid=3033%2E878179%2EiTt2CA) Huge news, team: The NRSC was just caught lying about my record on the air, and in response, TV stations across North Carolina pulled down their attack ad against me. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14116?t=7&akid=3033%2E878179%2EiTt2CA) This is extremely rare in campaigns, but it speaks to how dirty the NRSC is going to play to try to win North Carolina's Senate seat. So we must continue to fight back. [**Please split a $5 donation between our campaign and Voter Protection Project right away to fight back against our opponents ' misleading smears and make sure voters know the truth.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14116?t=8&akid=3033%2E878179%2EiTt2CA) We said from the start that these attacks were false and that we would not stand down and allow them to lie about me or my record of upholding our Constitution and keeping North Carolinians safe.

Fortunately, in this case, the TV stations agreed and pulled the ad for having "false statement and language about North Carolina Democratic candidate Cheri Beasley."

We are the only Senate challenger they are attacking, and they've already crossed the line with these false attacks about my record.

Truthfully, this will not stop the NRSC. Another misleading attack ad is undoubtedly in the works -- with a real chance they try to attack me even harder.

But let me be clear: We are going to fight harder than you've ever seen from a Senate campaign in North Carolina. I've never backed down just because the challenges are steep or hard.

We're going to need you to have our back every step of the way. So I urgently need to ask for your help to make sure we're ready to fight against whatever Republicans throw at us next. name: Imani Oakley
subject: Thank you, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oakley for Congress
body:
Peter,
While tonight’s results weren’t what we’d hoped, I want to take a moment to say thank you.
To everyone who helped us build this progressive movement — who donated, volunteered your time, stood with us in our redistricting fight, or helped spread the word about our campaign — I am forever grateful.
Together, we earned national support for our movement, won the fight against New Jersey’s political machine to give Black voters a voice in NJ-10, and empowered thousands of people who’ve been left behind by a corrupt system.
But, sadly, we were outspent 3 to 1, and the establishment used every trick in the book to stop us.
Moving forward, I hope we’ve built the groundwork to take down NJ’s corrupt ballot line and corrupt political machine. Today’s misinformation, polling site irregularities, and voter manipulation proved that even after the crooked ballots were printed, New Jersey still didn’t act like a democracy. The political games proved how fragile the machine is and how dirty they’re willing to play.
I’m disappointed that the establishment’s dirty tricks, corporate funding, and anti-democratic ballot line won out, but I still believe in this movement, Peter.
The ballot line and our state’s corrupt political machine can be beaten, but it requires courage and sustained effort. And regardless of tonight’s results, I’m going to continue fighting for progress, standing up for our communities, and fighting back against corruption and injustice.
Inside or outside the halls of power, I know that together, we can continue winning key victories for our communities.
I’m not done fighting for change, and I hope you’ll continue to stand with me in this fight.
With gratitude,
Imani

Montclair, NJ 07042

We’re competing with the GOP for airtime.
#
Derek — after the GOP dropped $2.3 million on an ad attacking us last week, **we're fighting back with our VERY FIRST TV ads of the general election.**
[**_Will you donate now to get our two new ads on as many Pennsylvania TVs as possible?_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220607-2?refcode=em20220607-6134&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6134_434096_Prwl9c&akid=6134%2E434096%2EPrwl9c)
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47574?refcode=em20220607-6134&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6134%2E434096%2EPrwl9c) | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220607-2?refcode=em20220607-6134&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6134_434096_Prwl9c&akid=6134%2E434096%2EPrwl9c)
---|---
Creating and launching TV ads like this isn’t cheap, Derek.[**_
_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220607-2?refcode=em20220607-6134&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6134_434096_Prwl9c&akid=6134%2E434096%2EPrwl9c)
From cameras to video editing to buying time in multiple PA media markets, launching these ads is a costly and labor-intensive component of our campaign. But it’s necessary to help us reach + mobilize the unlikely voters across PA.
Then there’s the fact that the GOP is already spending million$ attacking us and competing with us for airtime — and Dr. Oz will soon be spending million$ of his own cash on ads, too.
**We can’t afford to lose ground here.** That’s why we’re launching a TV Ad Fund and setting a goal to raise $75,000 into it by 11:59 p.m. tomorrow night.
[**_Help us keep our powerful new ads on the air so our campaign can reach millions of Pennsylvania households »_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220607-2?refcode=em20220607-6134&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6134_434096_Prwl9c&akid=6134%2E434096%2EPrwl9c)

Thank you, Derek. Every single dollar we raise is going to be crucial to helping our campaign and its message reach every single community in PA.
More soon,
John

name: Chris Coulombe to Congress 2022
subject: Vote! Vote! Vote!
body:
It has been a long journey. Thousands of miles driven, hundreds of miles walked, countless handshakes and conversations with people up and down the North Coast.

| | [](http://avp.nationbuilder.com/?e=52bdf2ee8edf0eacfb7f7ef923d0ccf6&utm_source=avp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_day_gotv&n=1)
---
**Dear Friend,** It has been a long journey. Thousands of miles driven, hundreds of miles walked, countless handshakes and conversations with people up and down the North Coast. **And with your help, today our journey will reach new levels.** Turning around our region, our state, and our country is within grasp. But it starts by standing, by electing the right leaders, one vote at a time. Today, vote **Chris Coulombe for California’s 2nd Congressional District**. If you’ve already voted - thank you! Reach out to friends and encourage them to vote as well, the more that stand the stronger we are. If they need help returning their ballot or finding a polling place share this link: [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/polling-place](https://avp.nationbuilder.com/r?u=zxJBdFO2LZRu4lDamvUPFhwBA-ts7btnIExY3uyIgX6pQM22gJ11H3B1yZpPq0uq&e=52bdf2ee8edf0eacfb7f7ef923d0ccf6&utm_source=avp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_day_gotv&n=2) Together, we will choose a better future. Thank you for all your support these past few months.
Always my best,
**Chris** | [](https://avp.nationbuilder.com/christocongress?e=52bdf2ee8edf0eacfb7f7ef923d0ccf6&utm_source=avp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_day_gotv&n=3 "CONTRIBUTE") [CONTRIBUTE](https://avp.nationbuilder.com/christocongress?e=52bdf2ee8edf0eacfb7f7ef923d0ccf6&utm_source=avp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_day_gotv&n=3)

**Friend,

There’s nothing quite like Virginia History. **The home of eight U.S. Presidents. Patrick Henry. Jamestown. Colonial Williamsburg. Doug Wilder. Virginia’s history is America’s history. This history of the greatest Country this world has ever known. It is rich and worth celebrating. **It is worth saving and preserving.**

That’s why my campaign launched a **“Celebrate, Don’t Cancel”** tour on Sunday of the Seventh District, quite possibly the most historical district in the Country, visiting landmarks throughout the Seventh dedicated to our Founding Fathers, including the **boyhood home of George Washington, Ferry Farm in Fredericksburg.** We also visited the **office and museum** of our fifth President and founding father, **James Monroe,** in addition to **the birthplace** of our fourth President and drafter of our Constitution, **James Madison.** [](http://links.yeslivegaforvirginia.com/u/click?_t=876a4969a9724ab8bc814d84bfee8268&_m=8da914054e5a4cbe814c65352e09d3a2&_e=N6cQLeq2ua9E3aL0XDTuITGgUlVeuGFyJTOtK97OzZax1Ed5wFr85w8_pkI33a8ulj0aDNGYpCFadkBbkkuohBXHMXkQu8OsuH1GjxSUkVr493XN1tNpUTWUGroaBxzU5YcdqQSJmBmuwE08w1AgQER0CBrT40xaT6OVB_gAgqTw1PtSXm4dOuEZQQ9KOhl7EPMoZABKXg0VkqbSqcKZ4aDvuJbVDCBwAbra9qvDHqCMr3e_HIf6_6Z9qLKRaGu7PZ85m7SjylJEklyImA49iCCGU_M0O-UqVfyXl-u02kFswxAsF7ZnIBjI2HTm7NTcrQE2oNhY6w50iHzHsQX1Tf1axEkUu3mqzUqSrLl-xZrw2kmNEbnhnDlukOKkSGyyptU5Kmt4S3cGSc909DYAK3NEKqBB_VqfVxLxNpcz7AX-oRCzJWu_xma_yazU0eLZXtQtQFEW1P6W5ru36StLGb4HvQvcHlIgCwjimnmm1kp58b65AylMVsIu7lkRzHsG)
**The wisdom and foresight of our founders in creating a government ensuring liberty and justice for all are unparalleled.**

Yet we see every day how the Left (and even some Republicans) are ashamed of that history and want to erase it and tear it down.

Instead of lifting it up as a shining example and a beacon of freedom they choose to focus solely on the few dark moments and the fallen sin of nature for which no country or history can escape or claim perfection. Yet this one has come the closest.

**One of my Republican opponents vying for this nomination, Senator Bryce Reeves,****[was one of only two Senate Republicans to join with every single Democrat and Ralph Northam in voting to allow Defending and preserving Virginia’s history is one of the issues that will be on our ballot June 21st. We can’t afford to send someone who has already joined with the Woke-Left to Washington.

**We’ve already seen that this vote didn’t end with the Left stopping at Stonewall Jackson and Robert E. Lee.** Of course not. They immediately then started going after **George Washington, Thomas Jefferson. James Madison, and even Abraham Lincoln** in their insatiable desire to cancel and erase Virginia and America’s past. The bill Senator Reeves voted for didn’t just authorize the ability to destroy confederate monuments. It gave liberal localities throughout Virginia the ability to tear down and destroy ALL American war monuments, from the Revolutionary War to Iraq and Afghanistan. As a result, 25 monuments throughout the Commonwealth, including in Charlottesville, Caroline and King George Counties came tumbling down like a statue of Saddam Hussein within a year and a half.

Has Virginia’s history been perfect? No. But show me a place that’s been perfect and I’ll show you heaven. **Virginia history is American history. And America’s history is one we should all be darn proud of and defend.**
