clean_body: Primary Day is 14 Days Away | Friend, There’s nothing quite like Virginia History. The home of eight U.S. Presidents. Patrick Henry. Jamestown. Colonial Williamsburg. Doug Wilder. Virginia’s history is America’s history. This history of the greatest Country this world has ever known. It is rich and worth celebrating. It is worth saving and preserving. That’s why my campaign launched a “Celebrate, Don’t Cancel” tour on Sunday of the Seventh District, quite possibly the most historical district in the Country, visiting landmarks throughout the Seventh dedicated to our Founding Fathers, including the boyhood home of George Washington, Ferry Farm in Fredericksburg. We also visited the office and museum of our fifth President and founding father, James Monroe, in addition to the birthplace of our fourth President and drafter of our Constitution, James Madison. The wisdom and foresight of our founders in creating a government ensuring liberty and justice for all are unparalleled. Yet we see every day how the Left (and even some Republicans) are ashamed of that history and want to erase it and tear it down. Instead of lifting it up as a shining example and a beacon of freedom they choose to focus solely on the few dark moments and the fallen sin of nature for which no country or history can escape or claim perfection. Yet this one has come the closest. One of my Republican opponents vying for this nomination, Senator Bryce Reeves, I’ve met many in the district that are surprised by this, and I’ll admit that I couldn’t believe it at first myself. Defending and preserving Virginia’s history is one of the issues that will be on our ballot June 21st. We can’t afford to send someone who has already joined with the Woke-Left to Washington. We’ve already seen that this vote didn’t end with the Left stopping at Stonewall Jackson and Robert E. Lee. Of course not. They immediately then started going after George Washington, Thomas Jefferson. James Madison, and even Abraham Lincoln in their insatiable desire to cancel and erase Virginia and America’s past. The bill Senator Reeves voted for didn’t just authorize the ability to destroy confederate monuments. It gave liberal localities throughout Virginia the ability to tear down and destroy ALL American war monuments, from the Revolutionary War to Iraq and Afghanistan. As a result, 25 monuments throughout the Commonwealth, including in Charlottesville, Caroline and King George Counties came tumbling down like a statue of Saddam Hussein within a year and a half. Has Virginia’s history been perfect? No. But show me a place that’s been perfect and I’ll show you heaven. Virginia history is American history. And America’s history is one we should all be darn proud of and defend. Poll Shows Neck and Neck Race Between Vega and Reeves An The poll of 577 likely voters in the Seventh District shows just a one-and-a-half-point difference between our campaign and Senator Reeves, well within the poll’s margin of error. I’m the only candidate in this race that has pledged to join the group of true conservative fighters in Congress via the Freedom Caucus. And our campaign’s ability to win in deep blue Prince William County (at the peak of the blue wave in 2019) gives us the best opportunity to win this seat back for the GOP in the general and send Abigail Spanberger and Nancy Pelosi packing. Endorsed by Congressman Bob Good! We were delighted to receive the endorsement of Freedom Caucus member and Congressman from the neighboring district, Congressman Bob Good! Congressman Good is a man of strong faith and principle and has been a leading conservative voice in Washington. Until redistricting, Congressman Good represented Greene and Madison counties , which of course are now part of the Seventh. Thank you for your support, Congressman! **Endorsed by President Trump’s Border Patrol and ICE Chief We also were honored to receive the endorsement of President Trump’s former Border Patrol Chief and ICE Director, Ron Vitiello. Director Vitiello worked to secure our borders and enforce our nation’s immigration laws for almost 35 years. Anti-Human Trafficking Leader Endorses Vega As a law enforcement officer, mother, and Christian, the issue of eradicating human trafficking is a personal one for me. The issue of human slavery still exists, and it exists right here in Virginia. I saw firsthand the consequences of Barack Obama and Joe Biden’s wide-open border as a police officer and deputy sheriff. Young girls being brought across the border and trafficked by gangs like MS-13 in Prince William County and elsewhere. That’s why I’m so thankful for Bill Woolf, the CEO of Anti-Trafficking International and the amazing work he and his team do in liberating God’s children from human slavery in the U.S. and abroad. As your next member of Congress, eliminating this scourge within our country will be one of my very top priorities. Thank you for your support, Bill! Bill Woolf joins a growing list of conservative and Republican influentials endorsing our campaign, including: Congressman Dave Brat Ken Cuccinelli Senator Ted Cruz Congressman Bob Good Corey Stewart David Bossie Ginni Thomas Congressman Louie Gohmert Larry Pratt, Gun Owners of America Richard Viguerie Congressman Tom Davis Greene County Sheriff, Steve Smith Prince William County Sheriff, Glen Hill Orange County School Board Member, Chelsea Quintern Greene County School Board Vice Chair, Todd Sansom Culpeper County Supervisor, Susan Gugino On Fox and Friends Yesterday morning I had the opportunity to join Fox and Friends to talk about why Hispanic voters are leaving, in droves, a Democrat Party increasingly hostile to faith, family, freedom, and the rule of law and coming over to their natural home with the GOP. I saw this shift up close last year as the State Chair of the Latinos for Glenn Youngkin campaign which successfully brought out 55% of the Hispanic vote for now-Governor Youngkin. This record turnout was a direct result of bringing our unapologetic conservative message directly to Hispanic voters. As our nominee, I’m the only one that will be able to go toe to toe with Abigail Spanberger and improve even further upon these numbers. Upcoming Event: Lunch Rally with Congressman Louie Gohmert in Orange! Mark your calendars. This Friday, we’ll be having a special lunch rally with Congressman Louie Gohmert (you know him from Fox and C-Span) in Orange County beginning at 11:30am. Big Turnout for Rally with Ken Cuccinelli in Culpeper We were blessed with a beautiful evening and close to 50 Patriots for our rally on Friday evening in Culpeper with former Attorney General, Ken Cuccinelli! Ken spoke eloquently about defending life and the rule of law. He was a hard act to follow but I was blessed and honored to have his support and such a large audience to come out and learn more about our campaign. Special thanks to the Culpeper County GOP for opening up their headquarters to host the event! Meet and Greet with John McGuire and Three Democrat Trackers! We also had a well attended meet and greet with State Del. (and former 7th District candidate) John McGuire at Crossroads Baptist Church in Fredericksburg. Hello,
A great honor has been bestowed on me. **Tonight, I officially became the Democratic nominee for Senate in Iowa against Chuck Grassley.**
This is a victory for all Democrats and for all Iowans calling for change.
I wouldn’t be sending you this email without the incredible backing of my family, our team, our incredible volunteers, and of course, supporters like you from across the entire country. Thank you.
I want to thank and congratulate my fellow Democrats, Abby Finkenauer and Glenn Hurst, on a good, honorable primary race. We kept it professional, for which I am proud, and I look forward to working alongside them and my fellow Democratic candidates to win up and down the ballot all across Iowa.
Iowa Democrats have spoken, and now we look toward holding Chuck Grassley accountable on November 8th and finally retiring him after 47 years.
There is so much at stake in this year’s election. Iowa and our nation are facing so many challenges and difficult problems that demand bold leadership and innovative solutions.
Democracy is under attack here at home and abroad. It’s time to hold the GOP insurrectionists accountable, and we must not forget the war against authoritarianism that the people in Ukraine are still fighting against Putin.
We need to finally address gun violence by taking on the NRA – not taking their blood money – and passing meaningful gun reform. After 36 years in the Navy, I know what weapons of war are capable of, and no one (especially not Chuck Grassley) is going to gun-splain me on this issue. It’s time for real action to save lives.
For too long, we’ve been under the ‘minority rule’ of Mitch McConnell and his obstruction. If we are going to codify Roe v Wade, pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act, or take bold action against climate change, the filibuster must go. I will be that 51st vote to set it aside and get the Senate working again.
I am so proud that we’ve funded our campaign with the support of over 66,000 grassroots donors like you and without one dime of corporate PAC money. Iowa needs a Senator who will work on behalf of Iowans, not corporate interests. I promise I will never be bought by special interests, and that includes Big Pharma and the insurance industry...
Because it’s time we pass universal health care so that everyone has the same kind of quality health care my family and I had when I was in the Navy. Whether you call it a single-payer system, Medicare for All, or something else – it’s time. Let’s do it.
The road ahead is not going to be easy. Chuck Grassley has taken millions of dollars from corporations and special interest groups, and Mitch McConnell has raised millions more into Super PACs to attack me. I bet Fox ‘Entertainment’ News is figuring out what lies to tell about me right now.
But I’m a hard target for the GOP. Chuck Grassley has never faced an opponent like me before. We are going to send Grassley packing, and we are going to do it by turning out Democrats, winning independents, and even swaying the pro-democracy Republicans I hear from every day.
I am ready for the fight, and I am so grateful to know I can count on your support along the way.
Thank you for everything you’ve done and will continue to do through November.
Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.)

| | | **_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

It’s important to me that your priorities are included in our plans.* That’s why I am reaching out to share our June Issues Survey. *FACT CHECK: A majority of Arizonans support reforming the filibuster. You ignore them, and haven’t hosted a town hall in years. We’re gearing up for a busy month* and the best way for me to hear what’s on your mind is through our survey. *EDIT: What, of vacations and ritzy closed-door fundraisers?
**Will you take a few minutes to share your priorities in our June Issues Survey so I can ensure I’m working on them in the Senate? Your voice matters****.*** *EDIT: The hypocrisy here is just **_astounding_**. You list “lowering prescription drug costs” in this survey when you single-handedly killed President Biden’s plan to allow Medicare to negotiate lower drug prices. You actively BLOCK our priorities by siding with Republicans on the filibuster! **Our voices don’t matter to you at all.** Thank you for sharing your thoughts with me. clean_body: Again and again, the elitist D.C. swamp imposes rules on every day Americans, but the rules never apply to them. | Peter, Democrats plan to take away our guns AND control what we do in the comfort of our homes? Not on my watch. In a hearing discussing Joe Biden’s attempt to ban magazines of more than ten rounds of ammunition, I utilized my own firearms to show my colleagues that the legislation makes ZERO sense. Here’s why: The majority of guns you and I use every day to protect ourselves, our families, and our homes use magazines that are greater than ten rounds of ammunition, which isn’t that much. But if Biden BANS them, he might as well ban all of our guns because we won’t be able to load them. Biden and the Democrats are disarming law-abiding citizens, ripping away our protection and Second Amendment rights, and I’ve had enough! | What blows my mind even more is that Democrats have spent HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS of dollars for their personal use of heightened security and bodyguards. But do you know what guns the bodyguards carry to protect them? Ones that require more than a 10-round magazine. I’m sick of the hypocrisy and the Democrats' games. Again and again, the elitist D.C. swamp imposes rules on every day Americans, but the rules never apply to them. body:
Delia’s primary is on June 28, so we need all hands on deck to help her win. Will you make calls to voters with us this week?
#
Peter, I wanted to reintroduce myself — I’m Carly, an organizer with Team Jayapal. And today, I’m writing because we need your help! **Here’s how:**
On Thursday, we’re hosting a virtual phone bank to call Democrats in Illinois’ new Third Congressional District to tell them about an amazing candidate Pramila has endorsed — **Delia Ramirez, who, if elected, would be the first Latina member of Congress from the Midwest!**
Delia’s primary is on June 28, so we need all hands on deck to help her win. [**Can you join our virtual phone bank this Thursday, June 9, from 7-10PM ET/6-9PM CT/4-7PM PT? We’ll kick things off with a brief conversation between Pramila and Delia — you don’t want to miss this!**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14369?utm_source=em20220607-1328&t=1&akid=1328%2E420207%2Ev28mGO)
**[Get more info + RSVP »](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14369?utm_source=em20220607-1328&t=2&akid=1328%2E420207%2Ev28mGO)**
_(Can’t make it?[**Chip in $3 to fuel our fight to re-elect Pramila, protect our Democratic majorities, and elect more people-first progressives like Delia to join Pramila in the House!**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14370?refcode=em20220607-1328&t=3&akid=1328%2E420207%2Ev28mGO))_
Every phone bank starts with a quick training, so even if you’ve never made calls before, we’ll make sure you have everything you need to talk to voters about why Delia Ramirez is the BEST choice for the people of IL-03.
As we head into one of the most consequential midterm elections ever, and Democrats prepare to make their case to the American people on why we deserve to retain our majorities in Congress, we must work to elect strong progressives like Delia who are unafraid to stand up to corporate greed and fight hard on behalf of the people. **And that work starts with phone banks like the one we’re hosting Thursday.**
[**So what do you say****, Peter? RSVP for Thursday’s virtual phone bank — it will take all of us doing our part to make sure Delia wins.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14369?utm_source=em20220607-1328&t=4&akid=1328%2E420207%2Ev28mGO)
Hope to see you there!
In solidarity,
Carly
Carly Peña (She/Her)
Organizer and Campaign Coordinator
Pramila for Congress
